"Treat Her Right" is a soul music song, with a standard 12-bar-blues structure.
Written by Roy Head and Gene Kurtz, it was recorded by Head and The Traits and released on the Back Beat label in 1965.

Background and recording
In 1965 the band signed with producer Huey Meaux of Houston.
Roy Kent Head (January 9, 1941 – September 21, 2020) was an American singer, best known for his hit song "Treat Her Right".
Head and fellow high school student Tommy Bolton founded musical group The Traits in 1957, with the band, billed as Roy Head and the Traits, scoring the international hit "Treat Her Right" in 1965.
Head later enjoyed a successful solo career with several hits on the country and western charts between 1975 and 1985.
